---
title: "Weekly surveillance report"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
lang: en-CA
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(islandbrand)
islh_setup(format = "html", quiet = TRUE)

weekly <- data.frame(
  week = seq(as.Date("2026-01-04"), by = "week", length.out = 12),
  cases = c(10, 12, 18, 29, 40, 52, 45, 31, 24, 18, 14, 10)
)
```

## Weekly pattern

Cases peak in the sixth week and then decrease. Hover over a bar for values,
drag to zoom, and double-click to reset.

```{r}
#| echo: false
islh_epi_curve(
  weekly, date = week, count = cases,
  title = "Reported cases by week",
  subtitle = "Simulated surveillance counts",
  caption = "Source: simulated example data"
) |>
  islh_plotly(height = 380)
```

## Weekly counts

Search for a week, click a column heading to sort, or move between pages.

```{r}
#| echo: false
islh_reactable(
  weekly,
  title = "Weekly counts",
  columns = list(
    week = reactable::colDef(name = "Week starting"),
    cases = reactable::colDef(name = "Reported cases")
  ),
  page_size = 5,
  source_note = "Source: simulated example data"
)
```
